app.name: Universal Downloader
app.tagline: Paste a link, see what is really there, download what you are allowed to.

legal.notice: Only download content you own or have permission to use. This tool does not bypass DRM, paywalls, logins or CAPTCHAs.

inspect.title: Analyze a link
inspect.label: Link (URL)
inspect.help: Supports direct file links (images, documents, audio, video, archives) and media pages from sites supported by yt-dlp.

result.title: Analysis result
result.notDownloadable: This link cannot be downloaded with the current settings.

warnings.SIZE_UNKNOWN: The server did not report the file size.
warnings.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the allowed limit.
warnings.WEBPAGE_NOT_FILE: This link is a web page, not a downloadable file.
warnings.RISKY_FILE_TYPE: This file type can run programs. It will never be opened automatically — only open it if you trust the source.
warnings.FFMPEG_MISSING: FFmpeg is not installed, so formats that need audio merging are limited.
warnings.PAGE_NOT_READABLE: The page could not be read to look for files.

media.title: Title
media.mergeAudio: Add the best audio track (needs FFmpeg)
media.mergeHint: The chosen format has no audio. FFmpeg will merge the best audio track without re-encoding the video.
media.noFfmpeg: FFmpeg is unavailable, so audio cannot be merged into video-only formats.

jobs.empty: No active downloads. Analyze a link to start one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Choose the interface language. The choice is saved in this browser.
settings.tokenHelp: Only needed when the server runs with AUTH_REQUIRED=true. Stored in this browser only.
settings.unavailable: The API server is not reachable.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: An unexpected error happened in the interface.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the API server. Is it running?
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_URL: That link is not valid. Use a full http:// or https:// address.
errors.BLOCKED_DESTINATION: This address is blocked for security reasons (local or internal network).
errors.UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE: This source is not supported, is private, or is protected.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: This link is a web page or a content type that cannot be downloaded.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the allowed limit.
errors.STORAGE_FULL: The server's temporary storage is full. Try again later.
errors.DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT: The source took too long to respond.
errors.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The source could not be reached or returned an error.
errors.TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: The link redirects too many times.
errors.INCOMPLETE_DOWNLOAD: The download was interrupted before it finished.
errors.FORMAT_NOT_AVAILABLE: The selected format is not available.
errors.MEDIA_TOOL_MISSING: A required media tool (yt-dlp or FFmpeg) is not installed on the server.
errors.JOB_NOT_FOUND: This job does not exist or does not belong to you.
errors.JOB_NOT_READY: The file is not ready yet or has expired.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This action is not possible in the job's current state.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have too many active downloads. Wait for one to finish.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please slow down.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: An access token is required. Add it in Settings.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: This request was blocked by the server's security policy.
errors.INTERRUPTED: The server restarted while this job was running.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server hit an unexpected error.

batch.title: Add many links
batch.label: Links (one per line)
batch.help: Each line is added to the queue as a direct download. Up to 50 links at a time.

links.title: Files found on this page ({n})
links.none: No downloadable files were found on this page.
links.streamNote: Streams (.m3u8) are saved at the best quality available and converted to MP4 when FFmpeg is installed. DASH (.mpd) is not supported yet.
links.savePage: Save this page as an .html file
links.linkNote: Other links may lead to web pages instead of files; those will fail with a clear message. They are not included in "Select all".
